svg.aria-label: Actual CPU profiling and separate timing. Top: three warmed-up Adam steps with profiler ranges. Lower left: operator self CPU time. Lower right: 12 groups of five complete SGD updates, with median lines. Different optimizers and instrumentation mean the range durations are not the timing benchmark.
